GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3-4l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, running on took over approaching 100m, drew 1 length clea b4 headed late # 1 better/gap to 3rd
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field Wide out 6 lengths. very Wide turn. battled away # Wide trip

Began well. Rolled fwd to lead on inside by 1 length early . Held lead on inside midrace & held together on inside (1L clear) on home turn. Pressured Two Wide @ 250m & headed @ 150m. Weakened once headed. # Led & weakened.
Jumped Ok went forward from outside barrier to sit 2nd .5l 600m .5 2nd Straightened Up 2nd tired final 150m # speed/tired late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early stages. Rider reported that the mare did not let down fully in the home straight due to the heavy ground. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 lengths. Wide turn 5 lengths. battled away # Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shortly after the start was hampered by another runner shifting in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 3 Wide 5 lengths. under pressure turn. battled away # Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 700m was steadied after shifting out & becoming awkwardly placed inside heels. Rdr stated after receiving early interference mount settled further back than anticipated. Rdr stated mount ground way to line in straight however could not make ground on leading division. Rdr stated mount should appreciate step up in distance so as to settle in more prominent posn. P/R vet no ab's.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well from the Inside . Settled Down 3rd the fence 2 Lengths @ 600m. Through Clear Two Wide on Straightening Up . Kept Going Soundly but No Match at all for $1.85 winner # sound effort
(front concussion plates first time) no vision until 600m. this Inside 3rd, 2 Lengths . nicely into Clear Straightening Up now 2nd 1 length . Kept Trying , $1.70 winner led # Sound in defeat

Jumped OK. Pushed fwd & raced 4th Two Wide (2.5L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed to quicken @ 400m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & weakened in last 150m. # Struggled last 200m
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5l. deeper Hard Ridden Turn . Straightened Up widest in Clear , Ran On Strongly and Made Good Ground into 3rd # finished off well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier, was directed behind runners during the early stages. Near the 300m was bumped by another runner, which shifted out.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began well. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (3L from lead). Held Ground midrace & pushed to quicken 3 Wide @ 450m. Pushed along Four Wide (3L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Five Wide @ 250m & ground home @ one pace in last 200m. # dw
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the turn near the 700m, was eased whilst awkwardly placed inside heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok ridden out, Improved 2 Lengths 3rd.hr chasing 3-4l away into Straight as Leader went Clear . Battled On Well for Clear 2nd # sound/leader won
